lines.en: I arch my back and inch forward.
I work along the leaf vein.
I have bitten through a leaf.
Many feet, slow going.
I reach the leaf's edge.
I have moved to another leaf.
Leaf crumbs are all beneath me.
I inch along in loops.

lines.zh: 我在叶背咬出一个个洞。
lines.en: I bite holes through the underside.
I move into the leaf's shadow.
This length of me is fat enough.
I chew slowly.
The blade bends under me.
I choose the tenderest edge.
I have eaten a great deal again.
I am nearly across the whole leaf.
I lie flat on the leaf.
My mouth is still chewing.
All day long I think of leaves.
I lift the front of my body.
The sun brightens the leaf.
When I move, a faint sound comes.
This part of me feels cool.

lines.zh: 离了叶子，我撑不了多久。
lines.en: Off the leaf, I will not last long.
I leave a row of small holes behind me.
Half a leaf is still in my mouth.
I look slowly left and right.
If nothing goes wrong, I will pupate.
Do not step on the leaf.
I raise my front half to look at you.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了整片叶。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the whole leaf.
I duck under the leaf.
You cannot blame me for eating.
Keep your hand away.
I poke my head out of the leaf hole.
I am still very small.
I cannot live on the ground.
You are blocking the sun.

lines.zh: 我把头尾都收进身子里。
lines.en: I pull head and tail into my body.
This part of me is trembling.
I clutch hard and the leaf edge curls.
My feet slipped; I dangle from the leaf edge.
I crawl more slowly now.
A little of me is torn.
I bite the stem and hold.
I steady myself with effort.
It still hurts badly.
I need to get back on a leaf.
This vein is soft; my bite goes through.
For anything but a leaf, I do not open my mouth.
Do not offer me anything else.

lines.zh: 这片叶子够我啃到结蛹。
lines.en: This leaf will last me until I pupate.
I chew my way across.
You may set it down.
I cannot bite hard things.
The leaf must be fresh.
I can smell whether it is tender.
I am ready for a new leaf.
The bump rolled me over.
I loop along on the ground.
The leaf was knocked down.

lines.zh: 滑下去半寸，我再爬回来。
lines.en: I slip half an inch and crawl back.
This part of me hurts.
I cling to the stem.
I am not far from dying.
You are blocking the vein I was crawling along.
I cannot find a leaf.
I will crawl back.
We eat our own leaves.
There are others of my kind on the leaf.
Eat first, talk later.
I must eat enough first.
Wait until I am fat enough.
We ignore each other.
Let us chew this leaf together.
Do not crowd me.
It is still early.
Keep chewing the leaf.
I gnaw off a bite.
I tap it with my antennae and turn away.
I nudge it.
Too hard to bite.
If it will not bite, I drop it.
I push it with my mouth; it will not budge.

All I can do is eat.
Not a leaf, so I turn away.
Leaves are better.
Something is leaning on the leaf.
I curl up.
I crawl downward.
The stem is swaying.

I must not fall.
I burrow to the underside.
That thing still clings to the leaf edge.
I keep still and do not shift.
I hope it leaves.
The leaf trembles; I stop.

I press flat and stay still.
I pull my head back.
There is still room to hide on the leaf.

Hold on a little longer.
I am hungry, but I dare not move.
It is nearly past.
I have nothing to fight with.
I coil my body into a tight ball.

I lunge, and hit nothing.
This is quite foolish.

I scramble up quickly.
Stop bothering the leaf.
I need a leaf.
I crawled away.
A caterpillar is on a leaf.
I chewed my way here bit by bit.
I land on the leaf.
A new hole in the leaf.
This body of mine is soft.

lines.zh: 我从卵壳里拱出来，先啃一口。
lines.en: I wriggle out of the egg and take a first bite.
Leaves are all around.

lines.zh: 我落在叶上，先咬破一点。
lines.en: I land on the leaf and take a first nibble.
I climb up from the underside.
This leaf will last me days.
Fire hits the leaf, and I flee downward.
I fell to the ground and cannot climb back.
Water rises, and I cannot breathe.
After the blast I cling to the leaf's edge.
Something sharp went into me.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的脚全僵了。
lines.en: That light stiffened every one of my legs.
This leaf is finished.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck the tree and I jerked.
There is not a single leaf here.
